identity.sql: SELECT USER AS LOGIN_USER,SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SERVICE_NAME') AS SERVICE_NAME FROM DUAL

choose_one_bill.sql: SELECT source_system,pharmacy_code,business_kind,source_bill_id FROM V_DRUG_TRACE_CODE WHERE bill_time>=:begin_time AND bill_time<:end_time AND ROWNUM<=1

baseline.sql: SELECT source_code_record_id,source_revision FROM V_DRUG_TRACE_CODE WHERE source_system=:source_system AND pharmacy_code=:pharmacy_code AND business_kind=:business_kind AND source_bill_id=:source_bill_id AND bill_time>=:begin_time AND bill_time<:end_time ORDER BY source_code_record_id

first_null.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT source_system, source_bill_id, pharmacy_code, business_kind, source_revision, source_line_id, source_code_record_id, trace_code, quantity, unit, code_level, parent_code, updated_at, is_deleted, f_trace_code, s_trace_code, t_trace_code, bill_time FROM V_DRUG_TRACE_CODE WHERE source_system = :source_system AND pharmacy_code = :pharmacy_code AND business_kind = :business_kind AND source_bill_id = :source_bill_id AND (:after_record_id IS NULL      OR source_code_record_id > :after_record_id) AND bill_time>=:begin_time AND bill_time<:end_time ORDER BY source_code_record_id) WHERE ROWNUM <= 2
